svg.text: CLAUDE CODE / HMRC MTD / VAT RETURNS WORKFLOW
DB to Box 1-9 to MTD: the full pipeline
Six lanes: source -> normalise -> categorise -> engine -> submit -> audit
Deterministic VAT computation. LLM only for classification and reconciliation hints. Human gate before submission.

g.text: Read-only DB role / idempotent run_key / GBP normalisation
Claude never gets write access to source data
INGEST + NORMALISE PLANE / CLAUDE CODE EMITS DETERMINISTIC SCRIPTS
Parquet / SQLite snapshot for the period
CATEGORISE + RECONCILE PLANE / CLAUDE CODE CLASSIFIER + ANOMALY FLAGS
VAT ENGINE PLANE / PURE-FUNCTION ARITHMETIC, NO LLM IN MATHS
sandbox first, only flip to production after dry-run signed off
AUDIT + GOVERNANCE PLANE / PROVE WHAT THE AGENT DID
DECISION MATRIX / CLAUDE CODE vs PACKAGED SaaS vs BESPOKE LEDGER
